title: Council to Provide Recommendations on Reasonable Integrated Shield Plan and Rider Premium Increases for Private Healthcare
what_it_is: Council to Provide Recommendations on Reasonable Integrated Shield Plan and Rider Premium Increases for Private Healthcare

sections.label: Integrated Shield Plan premium increases
sections.summary: The Ministry will not establish a council on Integrated Shield Plan and rider premium increases, leaving revisions to insurers' actuarial and commercial considerations and market forces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider establishing a council to provide recommendations on reasonable Integrated Shield Plan and rider premium increases for private healthcare.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Therefore, the quantum and frequency of premium revisions are subject to insurers' actuarial and commercial considerations which are best left to market forces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Government's role should be to ensure affordable, accessible and good quality subsidised healthcare for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Private professional fees and consumer protection
sections.summary: The Ministry is considering benchmarks for private professional fees, has taken enforcement actions against errant doctors, and intervened to improve consumer fairness and transparency.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Separately, we have also been looking at different modalities and approaches, including introducing benchmark for private professional fees to guide pricing and guard against overcharging.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have taken enforcement actions against a small minority of doctors who made errant claims.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have also intervened to improve consumer fairness and transparency.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will continue to work on these to make sure that consumers are protected.
